My research applies statistical and machine-learning methods to health data, with
an emphasis on prediction from electronic health records and on whether models
built in one setting remain trustworthy in another.

## Research projects

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Manuscript in preparation
:::

[Cross-Country Transfer Learning for ICU Admission Prediction](project-icu-transfer.qmd){.research-title}

::: {.research-authors}
PLACEHOLDER: author list · S-LAB, Jeonbuk National University · Feb 2026 – present
:::

Whether a clinical prediction model trained on one country's electronic health
records still works in another, and how much data from the target country is
needed to close the gap. Built on TabPFN, with target adaptation and a
label-noise analysis to test whether the reported gains are real.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-icu-transfer.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
UNLV 2025
:::

[Deep Neural Networks for Mortality Prediction from EHR Vital-Sign Time Series](project-ehr-mortality.qmd){.research-title}

::: {.research-authors}
Bokyung Shin, *Nam-Yoon Kim*, Hyunsoo Kim, Hyeonjong Yu · University of Nevada, Las Vegas · June – July 2025
:::

Predicting patient mortality from irregularly sampled vital signs recorded at a
Brazilian cancer center. Two interpolation schemes crossed with two network
architectures on the same cohort; the convolutional models won on every metric,
and the interpolation choice mattered far less than the architecture.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-ehr-mortality.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

## Conference posters

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
IC-KDA + ASAD 2025 · Best Poster Award
:::

[Effectiveness of Digital Cognitive Training Interventions for Dementia: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis](project-dementia-meta.qmd){.research-title}

::: {.research-authors}
Jiyoun Sung, *Nam-Yoon Kim* · May 2025, Seoul
:::

A PROSPERO-registered systematic review and meta-analysis of eleven randomized
trials, asking whether remotely delivered cognitive training improves cognitive
and depressive outcomes in dementia. It improved both, on a small evidence base.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-dementia-meta.qmd){.research-btn}
[PROSPERO CRD42025631806](https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/display_record.php?RecordID=631806){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Korean Statistical Society 2025
:::

[Deep Learning-based Neural Granger Causality for Solar Radiation Time Series](project-granger.qmd){.research-title}

::: {.research-authors}
Minwoo Lee, Sangmin Lee, Younghwi Cho, *Nam-Yoon Kim*, Gahee Kim, Youngmi Lee · June 2025, Gyeongju
:::

Which meteorological variables carry predictive information about solar
radiation, and whether neural Granger causality recovers relationships that a
linear vector autoregression misses. It does — for the variables that behave
least like continuous measurements.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-granger.qmd){.research-btn}
:::
